## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible or maintenance change.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Dependency or tooling maintenance

## Implementation details

List the important implementation decisions and affected areas.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci` completed.
- [ ] `npm test` completed.
- [ ] `npm run build` completed, or the reason it could not be run is explained.
- [ ] Relevant user flows were manually checked.
- [ ] Signed-out and wrong-owner access were considered where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets or private interview content are included.

## Data and security impact

- [ ] No database change.
- [ ] Database change described, including migration and rollback plan.
- [ ] Authentication or authorization impact described.
- [ ] AI prompt, provider, or generated-output contract impact described.
- [ ] Privacy and logging impact reviewed.

## Documentation

- [ ] README updated if user-facing behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] Relevant docs updated.
- [ ] `.env.example` updated if configuration changed.
- [ ] Known limitations and roadmap updated if scope changed.
